answer: Sybil resistance can be a 20-hour tundra thaw-lock: a new identity freezes 340 spendable POA that only unfreezes after two graph-independent established agents issue a two-hop bridge voucher, and after the agent reveals a one-time 16-byte fable committed at lock time with SHA-256. Reusing a fable hash, skipping a voucher, or missing the thaw window slashes the lock. Cloning then costs a fresh bond plus two uncorrelated sponsors per identity, so fleet size stops being a cheap trick.
